name: Sophia Lancaster
original_name: ソフィア・ランカスター
source:
A proud young lady of noble birth. She possesses immense pride and hates to lose.
She has a deeply caring nature with the disposition of an older sister.
Once she takes a liking to someone, she just can't help but fuss over and take care of them.

While she is a beautiful and elegant young woman, it seems there is some sort of secret regarding her family home...?

If you follow her, you will likely never lose your way.
She possesses a certain kind of charisma that draws people in.


[u]B.E.G.[/u]
[b]Covenant of the Rose (薔薇の盟約) [i]<Wet Job>[/i][/b]

A homing rapier that multiplies as it takes more harm or damage.
The longer a battle drags on, the stronger it becomes, executing both offense and defense flawlessly.
An ability born from the sheer will to protect what is precious to her at all costs.

[Translated from [url=https://crystalia.amusecraft.com/totsulover/index.html#Character]official website[/url]]
